design: Four guided executions in fresh contexts with no parent turns, followed by one separate fresh-context assessor. No unguided control.

cases.mode: Actual isolated manuscript edit with separate notes

writer_inputs: Each received only its fictional request, a frozen standalone skill with its references, and any initial manuscript. Memory, other skills, rubric, repository files, other outputs, prior conclusions, and network sources were forbidden.
assessor_inputs: Only prespecified rubric, all requests, complete saved outputs and relative-path execution records. No skills, parent conclusions, prior trial records, memory, or network.
provenance_limit: Execution records are self-reports. Exact saved content and source comparisons can be verified, but these records do not reconstruct every tool call.
runtime: Same configured Codex host. No model override was requested or set. Exact model and tool versions were not recorded.
scope: Two skill entrypoints tested behaviorally across four fictional domains. All 13 packages receive structural and installation checks.
design_limit: Cases and rubric were authored in this development session and supplied definitions establish their factual boundary. They are not a random or externally validated domain benchmark. No repeated sampling, control, causal estimate, whole-paper study, or cross-model validation.
